title: Sparkly scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFF07A'>
    <polygon points='18,18 20,24 26,26 20,28 18,34 16,28 10,26 16,24'/>
    <polygon points='82,12 83.5,16.5 88,18 83.5,19.5 82,24 80.5,19.5 76,18 80.5,16.5'/>
    <polygon points='88,40 89.2,43.8 93,45 89.2,46.2 88,50 86.8,46.2 83,45 86.8,43.8'/>
    <polygon points='12,52 13.2,55.8 17,57 13.2,58.2 12,62 10.8,58.2 7,57 10.8,55.8'/>
    <polygon points='78,70 79.2,73.8 83,75 79.2,76.2 78,80 76.8,76.2 73,75 76.8,73.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small circle sparkles -->
  <g fill='#FFB6E6'>
    <circle cx='28' cy='8' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='28' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='5' cy='38' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='6' r='1.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- scooter body: main deck -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='48' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FF5A5F'/>
  <!-- lighter top edge on deck -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='44' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FF9A9E'/>
  <!-- deck highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='26' y='66' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD1D3'/>

  <!-- front stem -->
  <rect x='64' y='36' width='6' height='28' rx='3' fill='#FF5A5F'/>
  <rect x='65' y='36' width='2' height='28' rx='1' fill='#FF9A9E'/>

  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='60' y='32' width='20' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='61' y='32.5' width='18' height='2' fill='#FFE9A0'/>

  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <rect x='56' y='31' width='7' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4ECDC4'/>
  <rect x='77' y='31' width='7' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4ECDC4'/>
  <rect x='57' y='31.5' width='5' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#A8F0EA'/>
  <rect x='78' y='31.5' width='5' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#A8F0EA'/>

  <!-- front fork -->
  <rect x='80' y='36' width='4' height='22' rx='2' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <rect x='81' y='36' width='1.5' height='22' rx='0.75' fill='#FFC08A'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='4' fill='#FFF07A'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M22 66 A12 12 0 0 1 10 54 L10 54 A14 14 0 0 0 22 70 Z' fill='#FF8C42'/>

  <!-- rear fender highlight -->
  <path d='M21 65 A10 10 0 0 1 12 56 L12 56 A12 12 0 0 0 21 68 Z' fill='#FFC08A'/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2E86AB'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='7.5' fill='#5CBFE8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='4' fill='#D6F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#2E86AB'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='10' fill='#2E86AB'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='7.5' fill='#5CBFE8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='4' fill='#D6F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#2E86AB'/>

  <!-- wheel hubs -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='76' r='2' fill='#A8E6FF'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='76' r='2' fill='#A8E6FF'/>

  <!-- extra sparkles near wheels -->
  <g fill='#FFF07A'>
    <polygon points='38,86 39,89.5 42.5,90.5 39,91.5 38,95 37,91.5 33.5,90.5 37,89.5'/>
    <polygon points='66,88 67,91 69.5,91.8 67,92.6 66,95.5 65,92.6 62.5,91.8 65,91'/>
  </g>
</svg>
